name: Huge counter (clock or number)
description: A full-frame counter: a small spaced mono label over one huge condensed number that races from a start value and settles on the final one. As a clock it reads HH:MM:SS with the hours in the accent colour (e.g. 00:03:06 racing to 07:42:19); as a number it shows an optional prefix and suffix. Dark by default: a near-black moody background with a soft vignette and white digits.
use_when: Lines about time sunk or piling up (hours spent editing, time wasted, waiting) or one big total the speaker names (hours, videos, messages, steps); a dramatic beat where a single number carries the line.

kicker.help: small spaced label above the number, e.g. 'HOURS SPENT EDITING'

from.help: start value; for format 'clock' it is seconds (186 = 00:03:06)

format.help: 'clock' renders HH:MM:SS, 'number' renders a grouped number (decimals follow 'to')

suffix.help: number format only; 1-2 characters sit at full size ('%', 'x'), longer words are set small beside the number ('hours')

dark.help: near-black background with white digits; false = clean cream background with ink digits (then prefer dark captions)
